title: C# Logic: Short-hand If & Switch
description: C# provides efficient ways to handle multiple conditions. The ternary operator '? :' is a shorthand for 'if..else', while the 'switch' statement is ideal for choosing one of many code blocks to be executed based on a variable's value.

challenges.title: Short-hand If
challenges.exercise: Use ternary operator to print 'Odd' or 'Even' for 'int n = 5'.
